verdicts.reason: Both cram the headline into a 4-line block that nearly fills the canvas, with a tight top margin. Both also break the original's centred stack: the subline is pushed bottom-left and wraps awkwardly ('Now in four / flavours.') beside a small CTA whose label is close to too small to read. A has slightly more breathing room. B's larger headline and CTA run closer to the right edge (CTA about 10px from it), so B looks more cramped.
